title: CT pulmonary angiography: pulmonary embolism with radiologist masks
description: Two CT pulmonary angiograms (1 mm, contrast) from the FUMPE dataset with the emboli marked by two radiologists: a saddle embolus and a large right pulmonary artery embolus. Headers had placeholder UIDs and dates, repaired before packing; pixel data are unchanged.

referenceTargets.label: Pulmonary embolism (FUMPE radiologists' mask)

provenanceDetail.method: label-edited/PAT005.mat 'Mask' (512x512x217): two radiologists marked the emboli with a semi-automated tool (Masoudi et al. 2018). Mask slice k belongs to file D(k+1) in name order, which is also ascending position (checked: equal counts, monotonic ImagePositionPatient, overlay on the opacified pulmonary arteries). Traced with skimage find_contours (0.5) and approximate_polygon (0.25 px) into image_px [col, row].
provenanceDetail.note: 80 slices with embolus; outline-vertex centroid (LPS mm) [17.3, 44.0, -754.6].

referenceTargets.unassessedNote: Only the emboli are referenced; lungs, pleura, heart and other findings are unassessed.
referenceTargets.teachingNote: Saddle embolus: the mask spans the main pulmonary artery bifurcation into both pulmonary arteries (checked by overlay).
